Convention on Mutual Administrative Assistance in Tax Matters (OECD/Council of Europe, extended to Gibraltar)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Proceeds of Crime Act 2015 (Laws of Gibraltar, Cap. 76); Financial Services (Money Laundering and Financing of Terrorism) Regulations 2019, as amended; Limited Partnerships Act 2017 (Laws of Gibraltar, Cap. 171); Beneficial Ownership (Register) Regulations 2020, as amended (statutory beneficial ownership register for partnerships); Criminal Justice Act 2015 (terrorist financing provisions); Sanctions (Implementation) Act 2019 and Gibraltar Sanctions Regulations 2020; all administered under the supervision of the Gibraltar Financial Intelligence Unit and Registrar of Companies.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Gibraltar Registrar of Companies or the competent registry of the jurisdiction of incorporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille issued by the Gibraltar Attorney General's Chambers or the foreign state's competent apostille authority

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarised passport copy and proof of residential address for each beneficial owner, general partner, and limited partner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the country of residence or relevant government passport/civil registration authority
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille for Hague member states; consular legalization for non-Hague states

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Character / criminal record extract for each general partner and beneficial owner (where obtainable)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: National police, Ministry of Justice, or government criminal records authority of each individual's country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization as applicable

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified bank reference letter or professional introducer certificate evidencing source of funds and source of wealth
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: A licensed bank, authorized financial institution, or a regulated professional services firm providing the introduction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarisation followed by Hague Apostille where the reference is relied upon in a foreign jurisdiction

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all partners, beneficial owners, the general partner, and any authorised signatories against (i) the Gibraltar Sanctions List maintained by the Gibraltar Financial Intelligence Unit, (ii) the United Nations Consolidated List, (iii) the UK HMT/OFSI consolidated sanctions list, (iv) retained EU consolidated sanctions lists, and (v) the US OFAC SDN list for foreign-correspondent risk. FATF Recommendation 12 enhanced due diligence applies to all domestic and foreign PEPs, including family members and close associates. Screening is performed at onboarding, upon any change in partners or beneficial ownership, and continuously through transaction monitoring. Suspicious activity reports (SARs) must be filed with the Gibraltar Financial Intelligence Unit within 15 days of forming suspicion. Source-of-funds and source-of-wealth documentation is mandatory for non-face-to-face onboarding, notwithstanding the low-risk standard tier of Steam and PlayStation Store publishing receipts.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Gibraltar Companies Registry e-Registry (official portal at www.gibraltarcompaniesregistry.gi); name reservation is submitted via a licensed corporate service provider or the Registry's prescribed paper form
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The register operates exclusively in English; the legal name of the ELP must be in Latin script and may not be registered in any non-Latin script. Foreign-language or non-Latin commercial names must be transliterated or romanised into a Latin-script version. The name of an Exempted Limited Partnership must end with the suffix 'Limited Partnership' or 'LP' and must not be identical or misleadingly similar to any existing registered name or protected business name.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Investment Fund, Unit Trust, Mutual Fund, Collective Investment Scheme
Royal, Crown, Sovereign, Government, Municipal, Official, Authority
Gibraltar, Gibraltar Finance, Chamber of Commerce (where implying official or state connection)
Charity, Charitable, Foundation (unless separately approved by the Attorney General or Civil Registrar)
Co-operative, University, College, Institute, Society (where implying regulated or professional status)
Obscene, profane, or morally offensive words (absolute prohibition)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon name rejection, the Registrar of Companies must provide written reasons. The applicant (through its licensed corporate service provider) may file a request for administrative reconsideration with the Registrar within 14 days of the notice, accompanied by the prescribed form and administrative fee. If the Registrar affirms the rejection, the applicant may appeal to the Supreme Court of Gibraltar within 21 days of the affirmation under the statutory review procedure of the Companies Act 2014 / Limited Partnerships Act 2017. In cases where rejection is based on a sensitive token requiring prior ministerial or Financial Services Commission approval, the applicant may, instead of appealing, apply directly to the relevant supervisory authority for written consent and resubmit the name with that consent attached.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A purely virtual or non-physical registered office is not permitted. The ELP must maintain a registered office at a physical address in Gibraltar. The office may be provided by a licensed corporate service provider at the provider's premises, functioning as a hybrid physical-registered-agent arrangement. Remote operational management of the digital publishing business (Steam / PlayStation Store contracting and payout administration) is legally acceptable; however, the ELP must maintain adequate substance either in Gibraltar or, where applicable, in the United Kingdom, and must preserve accounting records, board or partner meeting minutes, and contractual records in accordance with the Limited Partnerships Act 2017 and Gibraltar Tax (Economic Substance) Regulations. The ISIC 5820 publishing activity is not classified as a geographically mobile activity under the Gibraltar economic substance regime, so no enhanced substance test is imposed; however, UK tax-residence planning requires demonstrable management and control substance outside Gibraltar.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low to moderate; estimated annual probability of an unannounced physical inspection by the Registrar of Companies or the Gibraltar Financial Intelligence Unit is approximately 5-10% for an ELP with a licensed registered agent and fully non-resident partners, reflecting risk-based supervision. The probability modestly increases to approximately 10-20% over the first three years where the ELP seeks UK tax residence or registers for UK VAT, as such status invites documentary verification and possible HMRC-led cooperation checks.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarisation and apostille bundle covering identity and address documents, good standing certificate, certificate of character, and bank reference letters (4-6 documents)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark: notarisation at GIP 25-75 per document plus apostille at GIP 20-45 per document; total GIP 250-350 (approx USD 320-450)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered office and licensed registered agent services for the ELP (12-month period)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed corporate service provider (TCSP) in Gibraltar
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for ELP registered office plus agent compliance package - GIP 500-900 (USD 650-1,200)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: AML/CFT onboarding, PEP and sanctions screening, source-of-funds verification, and risk assessment by the licensed TCSP

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark fee per client onboarding under the Financial Services (Money Laundering and Financing of Terrorism) Regulations 2019

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark annual compliance bundle covering registers, books, minutes, and substance documentation

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Gibraltar Limited Partnerships Act 2016 (as amended), Part II (Registration) and s.8 (Exempted Limited Partnership status); Companies Act 2014 (Cap. 100) insofar as general partnership provisions are incorporated
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Gibraltar Financial Services Commission (GFSC) – Registry of Limited Partnerships, P.O. Box 940, Suite 3, Ground Floor, Eurotowers 4, Europort Road, Gibraltar GX11 1AA
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Form LP-1 (Application for Registration of a Limited Partnership) together with Statement of Particulars and Statement of Initial Designated Partner
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital for an Exempted Limited Partnership; contributions may be in cash, property, or services as stated in the partnership agreement; no escrow requirement under Gibraltar law
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED that the partnership adopt the name KY_ELP (Gibraltar) Exempted Limited Partnership, and approve the subscription of capital contributions set out in the partnership agreement. RESOLVED that the registered office be established at Suite 3, Eurotowers 4, Europort Road, Gibraltar. RESOLVED that the General Partner appoint [Name] as Designated Partner, [Name] as Commercial Manager, and [Name] as Compliance Officer to execute the digital game publishing and distribution business. RESOLVED that the partners be admitted as initially identified, and the Designated Partner be authorised to file the registration application with the GFSC and execute all ancillary documents including the bank account opening mandate.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Pre-registration name search and availability confirmation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Gibraltar Financial Services Commission (Registry of Limited Partnerships) – online name search portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name availability request for 'KY_ELP (Gibraltar) Exempted Limited Partnership' via the GFSC Companies and Limited Partnerships E-Registry system. Obtain advance written clearance (Name Reservation Certificate) to reserve the name for 28 days.
required_dossiers: Completed Name Availability Request Form (NAR-1)
Entity identification summary (name, jurisdiction, proposed activity)
Identification of General Partner
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If name is refused for conflict or confusion, submit a revised name with documentary proof of distinction or obtain a written waiver from the conflicting entity within 14 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution of limited partnership deed and internal governance documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public and Licensed Fiduciary (Gibraltar) – execution in private or before notary
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft and execute the Exempted Limited Partnership Agreement (ELPA), including clauses for capital commitments, profit-sharing ratios, assignment of interests, dissolution events, and designated partner authority. If any partner is a corporation, annex certified copy of board resolution approving participation.
required_dossiers: Draft ELPA executed by all general and limited partners
Certified board resolutions of corporate partners
Proof of registered address of each partner
Identity and address verification for Principals (KYC pack)
Consent to act as Designated Partner (Form CDP-1)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If notarization is avoided and GFSC queries the deed, arrange for a supplementary notarial attestation of signatures and re-submit the corrected ELPA within 10 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing of registration application with GFSC
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Gibraltar Financial Services Commission – Registry of Limited Partnerships (E-Registry online filing portal)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete and submit Form LP-1 together with the Statement of Particulars, Statement of Designated Partner, registered office consent, and proof of Name Reservation. Pay the filing fee of GBP 280 (approx. USD 350) online via Enterprise Gibraltar portal. Upon approval, the GFSC issues a Certificate of Registration as an Exempted Limited Partnership.
required_dossiers: Form LP-1 (Application for Registration)
Name Reservation Certificate (from Step 1)
Notarized Certificate of Registered Office (Form RO-1)
Statement of Designated Partner (DP-2)
Certified copy of executed ELPA
KYC documents for all partners (passport, proof of address)
Filing fee payment receipt
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is queried, the GFSC issues a formal notice; respond within 21 days by filing supplementary declarations, revised periods of sanctions checklist, or updated KYC documents. Non-response leads to deemed withdrawal.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: GFSC Registry and internal management of the ELP
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Following certificate issuance, open statutory records: ledger of partners, register of charges, and minute book. Appoint a GFSC-recognized local 'Designated Individual' if the General Partner is not a Gibraltar resident. Appoint a licensed auditor if gross turnover exceeds EUR 50,000 equivalent (consolidated group basis).
required_dossiers: Certificate of Registration of Exempted Limited Partnership
Completed Form DP-2 (designated partner acceptance)
Register of Partners and register of beneficial owners (BO Registry form)
Letter of engagement with licensed Gibraltar fiduciary/auditor
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If statutory books not opened within 30 days, the ELP is subject to late-filing penalties; claim mitigation by submitting a prompt self-declaration of inadvertent omission and payment of mitigation tariff.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registrable beneficial ownership filing with GFSC
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Gibraltar Financial Services Commission – Beneficial Ownership Register
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the Beneficial Ownership Confirmation Statement (BOCS) identifying all individuals with >25% interest or control of the ELP. This is mandatory under the Gibraltar Beneficial Ownership Regulations 2019, subject to EU standards. Update within 28 days of any change.
required_dossiers: Form BO-1 (Confirmation statement of beneficial owners)
List of partners with percentage holdings and control rights
Certified identification documents of all beneficial owners
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the BO Register is rejected due to incomplete identification, provide corrected passport data and proof of residential address, and re-file within 7 days; late penalty is GBP 100 per day unless dispensation is granted for minor errors.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Open corporate bank and payment processor institutional account
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Private commercial bank or Electronic Money Institution licensed by GFSC – no state registry involvement
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the Certificate of Registration, ELPA, BO filing, and KYC pack to a GFSC-licensed bank (e.g., Gibraltar International Bank or St. Martin's Private Bank) to open an IBAN-denominated commercial operating account. Also apply for merchant and payout accounts with Steam (Valve Corporation) and PlayStation (Sony Interactive Entertainment), providing the ELP certificate and beneficial ownership structure.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Registration of ELP
ELPA and partner resolutions
BO Registry confirmation with GFSC
Passports and proof of residence of all directors/partners
Business plan describing Steam and PlayStation Store payout flows
AML compliance manual for the ELP
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If bank account is declined due to lack of local substance, appoint a Gibraltar resident Executive Consultant or expand the ELP to maintain a physical local office; then re-submit the application with updated substance proof.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Gibraltar Trade, Licensing and Consumer Affairs Department (TLAC) – Industrial Licensing Unit, 25 Governor's Parade, Gibraltar
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Business Premises and Digital Distribution Licence (under the Gibraltar Business Licensing Regulations) – Category EG-01 (Electronic Game Distribution)

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of the Environment, Sustainability and Climate Change (DESCC), Gibraltar
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Registration tier (low-impact digital services; no physical hardware production) – full EIA not required because no manufacturing or physical transformation takes place in Gibraltar
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Applicable to server/server rooms and any future office: aggregate data centre PUE < 1.5, waste electrical and electronic equipment (WEEE) disposal per EU/Gibraltar WEEE Regulations 2014, and compliance with Data Protection Act 2019 where personal data of account holders is processed. No wastewater-VOCs, as purely digital publishing.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certificate from Gibraltar Civil Defence and Fire Control: required for any office premises above 100 sqm or if staff >5; will require a means-of-escape plan, fire alarm maintenance contract, and portable extinguisher inspection. Structural load inspection is waived for purely office use (final confirmation by Building Control). Workplace occupational safety registration under the Health and Safety at Work Act 1996 with a written workstation DSE assessment for all personnel.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: HM Government of Gibraltar - Income Tax Office (ITO), headed by the Commissioner of Income Tax; entity registration: Gibraltar Companies House (Registrar of Companies); official portal: https://www.gibraltar.gov.gi/taxation
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: 1. Register the ELP with the Gibraltar Companies House under the Limited Partnerships Act 2011 and obtain a Certificate of Registration. 2. File the partnership registration application with the Income Tax Office (ITO) to obtain the ELP's Gibraltar Tax Identification Number (TIN). 3. Submit a declaration of non-residence where all partners are non-resident and control/management is exercised outside Gibraltar, confirming the ELP is outside the territorial charge to Gibraltar income tax. 4. Obtain a separate corporate TIN for any corporate general partner via the ITO's corporate registration procedure. 5. No VAT registration exists or is possible in Gibraltar; register with HM Customs Gibraltar only for physical importation of goods. 6. Maintain the register of beneficial owners and file annual return/accounts with the Companies House as required.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Pass_Through_Eligible - the ELP is fiscally transparent; partners are taxed on their distributive shares of Gibraltar-source income; a non-resident ELP with no Gibraltar-source profits is outside the charge on territorial-scope grounds; no Tax_Exempt_Zone status applies.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Gibraltar law provides a statutory election for a limited partnership to be treated as a body corporate for income tax purposes; absent that election, default pass-through treatment applies. No US-style check-the-box election and no domestic hybrid-mismatch election are available; the EU ATAD is not directly applicable in Gibraltar. The election should be made before the first return filing and evaluated alongside the ELP's non-residence position.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: None - Gibraltar does not levy VAT, GST, or sales/use tax; indirect taxation is confined to Customs Import Duty and Excise Duty on physical goods. Digitally delivered PC/console game publishing via Steam and PlayStation Store is not within any Gibraltar indirect tax.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Not applicable - there is no indirect tax registration threshold in Gibraltar for digital services. Import duty is triggered only at the border upon physical importation into Gibraltar and is not turnover-threshold based.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: None - Gibraltar has no real-time fiscal clearance, e-invoicing API, or digital stamping mandate. Standard commercial invoicing is sufficient; annual tax filings are submitted through the ITO e-filing portal. Non-Gibraltar VAT obligations (e.g., EU OSS or UK VAT on digital sales) may arise from customer locations but are outside the Gibraltar regime.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: VAT zero-rating is inapplicable because Gibraltar has no VAT. For income tax purposes, Steam and PlayStation Store publishing revenue falls outside Gibraltar tax on territorial grounds where the ELP is non-resident, all relevant activity occurs outside Gibraltar, and no Gibraltar-source profits arise. The ELP should evidence that contracting, platform operations, and service performance are wholly outside Gibraltar; no refund mechanism is required.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Not applicable - no Gibraltar customs declaration applies to intangible software exports
Steamworks/Valve partner payout statements evidencing non-Gibraltar platform receipts
PlayStation Partner/Store royalty reports from Sony Interactive Entertainment
Publishing, licensing, and distribution agreements demonstrating non-Gibraltar source
Bank records tracing settlement of platform payments outside Gibraltar
Gibraltar Partnership Return and ELP non-residence declaration (where relied upon)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: No VAT clawback exists. The Commissioner of Income Tax may raise assessments within six years of the chargeable period, with no time limit for fraudulent or negligent conduct. Incorrect returns or false non-residence declarations attract penalties of up to 100% of the tax undercharged plus statutory interest, and dishonest evasion may give rise to criminal liability. UK-Gibraltar exchange-of-information arrangements may support retrospective adjustments if platform payouts flow through the UK or EEA without adequate source documentation.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Gibraltar does not maintain a separate central bank or foreign exchange administration. The integrated financial regulator is the Gibraltar Financial Services Commission (GFSC), which licenses and supervises banks and executes the AML/CFT framework. The Gibraltar Pound (GIP) is issued by the Government of Gibraltar (HM Government of Gibraltar) under the Currency Notes Act 1934 and circulates at par with GBP. Monetary-policy anchor and ultimate sterling liquidity assurance rest with the Bank of England, while operational currency issuance sits with the Government of Gibraltar (Financial Secretary/Currency Commissioner). For FX-control matters, the applicable regime is the UK/Gibraltar post-1979 liberalized sterling area: no exchange control legislation remains in force.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Full current-account and capital-account convertibility applies. GIP is fixed at 1:1 to GBP, and GBP is legally tender alongside GIP; there are no surrender, approval, quota, or license requirements for converting USD, EUR, GBP/GIP, or JPY. Inward capital contributions (LP drawdowns), outward partner distributions, platform net-revenue remittances, and trade payments are free of central-bank authorization. The only convertibility friction is documentary: banks require accurate SWIFT purpose codes (e.g., 'CAPT' for capital contributions, 'TRAD' for trade, 'ROYC' for royalties) and a valid KYC/EDD file. Profit and partnership-distribution remittance from Gibraltar is unencumbered; withholding and reporting obligations are limited to CRS/FATCA and any U.S. tax documentation demanded by Valve/Sony, not to currency controls.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: None. Neither Gibraltar nor the United Kingdom imposes any statutory timeline, mandatory conversion ratio, or surrender requirement on export proceeds, including digital-game net revenue remitted by Steam/Valve and PlayStation/Sony. The ELP may leave USD, EUR, or JPY proceeds unhedged, retain them offshore, or convert to GBP/GIP at its treasury discretion. No 30-day, 90-day, or 180-day repatriation window applies, and no central-bank post-transaction reporting is triggered by retaining foreign currency. The only residual obligations are normal tax reporting (CRS/GATCA), accounting treatment of foreign exchange gains/losses, and, if U.S. platform payments are involved, holding a valid IRS Form W-8BEN-E to prevent backup withholding.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Multi-Currency Account (GBP/GIP, USD, EUR) with treasury and e-banking
Corporate Operating Account with USD clearing sub-account and FX lines
Corporate/Private Banking Account with ISDA hedging documentation

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Confirmation Statement (Annual Validation of Registered Particulars of the Limited Partnership)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Companies, Government of Gibraltar (Companies House, Main Street, Gibraltar)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 14 days after the end of each 12-month confirmation period commencing on the anniversary of the initial registration of the ELP; a further late filing grace period of 28 days applies before default penalties accrue.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty escalates from GIP 150 (approx. USD 190) after 1 month to GIP 750 (approx. USD 950) after 12 months; continued default triggers a formal strike-off notice by the Registrar and administrative dissolution of the partnership, with restoration available only by Court order.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Gibraltar Income Tax Return (Partnership Return Filed by the General Partner on behalf of the ELP)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Commissioner of Income Tax, Income Tax Office, Government of Gibraltar
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual return due within 9 months after the end of the accounting period, or, if earlier, the date stated in the notice of return issued by the Commissioner for the relevant year of assessment; for a 31 December year end the filing date is ordinarily 30 September of the following year.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Initial penalty of GIP 100 (approx. USD 125) plus continuing daily penalties of GIP 10 per day (maximum GIP 500 for the first default and GIP 1,000 for subsequent defaults); interest at 6% per annum accrues on any unpaid partnership tax liability; persistent non-compliance may lead to estimated assessments and disclosure to overseas tax authorities under exchange of information agreements.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual UBO (Beneficial Ownership) Confirmation and Partnership-Interest Transfer Update
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Companies (Central Beneficial Ownership Register), Government of Gibraltar
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual UBO confirmation must be delivered within 28 days of the anniversary of the first UBO registration; any transfer of a partnership interest that alters beneficial ownership (including Steam/console publishing royalty assignments) must be separately reported within 14 days of the change.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file is a criminal offence punishable by a fine of up to GIP 5,000 (approx. USD 6,300) plus a continuing default fine of GIP 100 per day; knowingly filing a false statement may result in imprisonment of up to 5 years; the ELP's limited-liability shield for limited partners may also be suspended.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Accounts and Statutory Books Delivery to the Income Tax Office (and to the Registrar where the audit exemption is not available)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Commissioner of Income Tax, Income Tax Office, and Registrar of Companies where the ELP exceeds the small-entity exemption
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Accounts covering each 12-month accounting period must be completed and filed with the partnership tax return within 9 months after the period end; for the Registrar, accounts must be filed within 28 days of the confirmation-statement deadline where audit exemption is lost.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late delivery penalties of GIP 200 to GIP 2,000 (approx. USD 250 to USD 2,500) depending on the period of delay; failure to file audited accounts when required automatically rescinds the audit exemption for the subsequent year, and repeated default may trigger administrative strike-off proceedings by the Registrar.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A qualifying Gibraltar limited partnership must appoint a certified auditor licensed by GIPA (Gibraltar Institute of Professional Accountants) if it breaches at least two of the following thresholds in two consecutive financial periods: annual turnover above GIP 6.5 million (approx. USD 8.2 million), balance sheet gross assets above GIP 3.26 million (approx. USD 4.1 million), or average workforce above 50 employees. Annual audit is also mandatory, irrespective of thresholds, if the ELP carries on regulated fund activities or is part of a consolidated group subject to Gibraltar Companies Act 2014 audit requirements.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS as adopted for use in Gibraltar (EU-derived IFRS) with FRS 102 Section 1A available for small entities; accounts are prepared on a historical-cost basis and must satisfy the Gibraltar Income Tax Act 2010 and the Companies Act 2014 (Cap. 100) for format, content and disclosure, including a partnership statement of income and capital contributions.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The ELP must maintain a central register of beneficial owners and file an annual UBO confirmation with the Registrar within 28 days of the anniversary of the first UBO filing. Every transfer of a partnership interest that affects the ownership or control structure (including transfers triggered by publisher payouts under Steam and PlayStation Store agreements) must be reported within 14 days under the 25% ownership or 25% control test. The UBO register is accessible only to competent authorities, tax authorities and law-enforcement agencies and is not publicly searchable.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (Limited and General Partners)
Register of Directors of the General Partner
Minute Book (general partner meeting minutes and partner written resolutions)
Register of Charges and Mortgages over partnership assets

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 900 – USD 2,800 per annum for a Gibraltar resident registered office, licensed Company Manager or registered agent, including maintenance of statutory registers, UBO register, and handling of annual confirmation filings.
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 4,000 – USD 12,000 per annum for a certified audit of a low-risk Gibraltar ELP holding PC/console publishing revenue with 2–5 partners, excluding bookkeeping and tax preparation fees.

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Zero-rate on foreign-source income for non-resident ELP partners; qualifying digital software copyright royalty income may benefit from the Gibraltar IP regime with a 50% deduction, yielding an effective rate of 6.25%; no capital gains tax, no net wealth tax, no dividend/interest/royalty withholding tax, and no stamp duty.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Gibraltar Partnership Income Tax Return (Form PP1) filed via the Gibraltar Tax Return Electronic Filing System (eTax)
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Filing deadline no later than 30 November following the end of the tax year (tax year ends 30 June); final tax payment due on the same date for unincorporated partnerships.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: ELP registered name and Gibraltar Partnerships Registry number
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the official legal name and registry number exactly as registered.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Principal place of business address and jurisdiction of management and control
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: State the non-resident address of the general partner or the designated representative if management and control is outside Gibraltar.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total gross trading receipts from Steam and PlayStation Store publishing activities
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report worldwide digital store revenue only if managed and controlled in Gibraltar or if a permanent establishment exists in Gibraltar; otherwise report only Gibraltar-source receipts.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total allowable trading expenses and platform store fees
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Deduct Steam Valve and PlayStation Store platform commissions, marketing, development costs, and administrative overheads directly attributable to the publishing activity.
Compute gross receipts minus allowable expenses using the partnership's profit-sharing ratio.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Allocation of taxable profit to each partner (name, address, tax residence, profit share %)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For non-resident partners, confirm that no Gibraltar permanent establishment exists and that the allocated share constitutes foreign-source income not subject to Gibraltar levy.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration of non-residence and claim for exemption from Gibraltar tax on foreign-source income
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Tick the declaration and submit a certificate of residence or equivalent proof of residence from the partner's tax authority.
Show only the amount available within the five-year carryforward period.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing of Form PP1 attracts an initial £100 penalty, plus a daily default penalty of £10 per day for up to 90 days; thereafter a 5% tax-geared penalty on unpaid tax for delay up to six months and a further 5% after twelve months; fraudulent or negligent returns expose the filer to criminal prosecution and fines up to £500,000.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Since domestic Gibraltar law imposes no withholding tax on income distributions, no DTA relief is required at the payor level. Where the recipient partner's country of residence taxes a Gibraltar distribution, the partner should obtain a Gibraltar Certificate of Fiscal Residence (TRC) from the Gibraltar Tax Authority at the Gibraltar Income Tax Office, using Form TRO-1, and thereafter file a treaty-relief claim with the foreign tax authority using Form GTRD, attaching the TRC, audited accounts, and a partner allocation statement.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties paid by the ELP to non-resident licensors: statutory rate 0%; treaty rate under the UK-Gibraltar double taxation agreement 0%. Interest paid to non-resident lenders: statutory rate 0%; no reporting obligation to the Gibraltar Commissioner of Income Tax.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Mandatory Local File and Master File required where annual related-party transactions exceed GBP 5,000,000 or gross revenue exceeds GBP 50,000,000.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: The Gibraltar Economic Substance Regulations (ESR) 2020 apply to entities carrying on relevant activities, including IP-holding and distribution; video game publishing via Steam and console platforms is characterised as a distribution/IP-related activity. The ELP must demonstrate economic substance in Gibraltar proportionate to its online activity through physical presence, staff, and management control. If the ELP is managed and controlled outside Gibraltar or possesses no local substance, it may file an annual Economic Substance Return (ESR-01) showing no relevant activity within Gibraltar, but failure to file or substantiate triggers penalties.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberately omitting digital store revenues or fabricating expenses in the annual tax return to reduce taxable profit, or failing to register for Gibraltar income tax where deemed resident.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Criminal prosecution under the Income Tax Act 2010; upon conviction, a fine up to £500,000 and/or imprisonment up to 7 years; unpaid tax reassessed without limitation, plus interest and surcharges up to 100% of the tax due.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The corporate veil may be pierced where the general partner knowingly authorises or participates in the evasion; directors or managers are jointly and severally liable for unpaid taxes, criminal restitution orders, and personal penalties; travel restrictions and seizure of assets may be imposed in the context of a tax fraud investigation.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating the ELP as a pure shell with no physical office, employees, or management in Gibraltar while relying on tax exemptions, or failing to file the ESR-01 Economic Substance Return.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fixed penalty of £10,000 under the Economic Substance Regulations 2020; continued default attracts a daily penalty of £2,000; the partnership may be struck off, and information is automatically exchanged with HMRC and other EU/OECD member tax authorities.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The Regulations empower the Gibraltar Registrar to impose penalties on the general partner and any designated person; court proceedings may additionally result in disqualification orders and a personal contribution order against the general partner for the ELP's penalties and unpaid taxes.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Accepting gross proceeds from Steam Player Payouts and PlayStation Store remittances without performing client due diligence or beneficial ownership verification, or failing to report suspicious transactions to the Gibraltar Financial Intelligence Unit (GFIU).
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the Proceeds of Crime Act 2015 and the Criminal Justice (Money Laundering) Act, non-compliance can result in an unlimited fine, imprisonment up to 2 years, and revocation of the ELP's registration; platform payout agreements may be suspended or terminated by Valve or Sony.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Where the general partner knowingly launders proceeds of tax fraud or evades AML obligations, personal criminal liability attaches with confiscation orders and travel bans; the partner remains personally liable for civil restitution and potential sequestration of personal assets.
